item.title: State Capitalism and Entrepreneurs in an International Setting
item.content:encoded:
David Ahlstrom, Hong Kong Metropolitan University

Gongming Qian, Shantou University

Jiatao Li, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Bin Liu, Xiamen University

This collection examines how different forms of state capitalism interact with entrepreneurship across international contexts, particularly in the Asia Pacific region. Following a period of state withdrawal through privatization, governments are increasingly intervening in enterprise, creating new institutional arrangements that affect how entrepreneurship develops and operates.

The collection investigates the mechanisms linking state capitalism varieties to entrepreneurial activities, including entrepreneurship within established corporations, the emergence of hybrid state-private ventures, and relationships between new ventures and state-influenced corporations. The focus is on understanding how these shifts reshape the institutional environments in which entrepreneurship occurs.

Appel publié par Asia Pacific Journal of Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
